description: repo-hygiene injects a SessionStart text that requires docstrings on every function. Claude Code cannot disable one hook of a plugin. Done: the ADW session contract in hooks/lib/hookio.py states that it overrides plugin and skill guidance and that a docstring demand does not apply. Open: the user adds `Skill(repo-hygiene:writing-docstrings)` to permissions.deny in ~/.claude/settings.json, because ADW self-protection blocks agent edits to that file.
title: Contract overrides plugin docstring demands
